tests.label: brightness adds to every color channel, not alpha
invert(…, 0.5) goes halfway: everything lands on 0.5

predict.question: Where osc is exactly 0.5, what does `osc(8).brightness(0.2).invert()` show? (Brighten first, then invert.)
predict.explain: **0.3.** 0.5 + 0.2 = 0.7, then 1 − 0.7 = 0.3. In the other order (invert, then brighten) you'd get 0.7: color functions don't commute, so the order you write them in matters.
